summary_1line: Duryodhana angrily dismisses fears of the Pandavas and boasts that his own supernatural power and destiny will ensure their annihilation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands before the Kuru court, furious and proud, declaring that even gods and storms would bow to his incantations.
Dhritarashtra sits troubled and sleepless in his palace while imagining Arjuna raining hundreds of arrows like thunder upon the battlefield.
